title: Rizzler
tagline: Location based gamified dating app that turns events into a treasure hunt for dates
description:
How It Works

User Authentication
- NFC Wristband Integration: Users authenticate using their ETHGlobal NFC wristbands
- Profile Fetching: User data is reverse engineered and fetched from the ETHGlobal website
- Instant Onboarding: Tap your wristband to join the game

Game Mechanics
- Target Update : Every 5min, the backend randomly selects one male and one female participant
- Arrow Navigation: All other users see directional arrows on their phones pointing toward the selected users
- Race to Connect: First person to physically find and scan the selected user's NFC wristband wins a point
- Real-time Tracking: GPS location enables accurate directional guidance
how_its_made:
Tech Stack
Frontend: Next.js with React hooks for real-time UI updates
NFC Integration: Web NFC API for wristband scanning
Location Services: GPS tracking with WebSocket communication
Privacy: Zero-knowledge proofs for user data via Mopro WASM
Backend: Real-time user selection and location broadcasting
World Mini App: The app exists as a mini app on World using the minikit
